title: FACS Staining of Phosphorylated Antigens
author: Karsten Lücke
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.q6rdzd6

steps.title: Aliquot cells into labeled tubes
steps.instruction: Pipette 1 mL of single‑cell suspension into each of six FACS tubes and label the tubes 0 min, 5 min, 15 min, 30 min, 60 min, and 120 min.

steps.title: Resuspend cells and incubate
steps.instruction: Resuspend the suspension to a concentration of 5 × 10⁶ cells · mL⁻¹ in complete IMDM medium and incubate for 2 h at 37 °C in 5 % CO₂.

steps.title: Time‑point incubation and fixation
steps.instruction: Incubate each tube for its designated time (0, 5, 15, 30, 60, 120 min). Immediately after the incubation, add 200 µL of 8 % PFA (final PFA concentration 1.5 %) and incubate at room temperature for 10 min.

steps.title: Centrifuge and discard supernatant
steps.instruction: Centrifuge the tubes for 5 min at 520 g and 4 °C, decant the supernatant, and resuspend the pellet in the original supernatant (return flow).

steps.title: Methanol permeabilization
steps.instruction: Add 1 mL of ice‑cold methanol to each tube and incubate on ice for 30 min.

steps.title: Wash with PBS/BSA and resuspend
steps.instruction: Add 3 mL of PBS containing 0.5 % BSA, centrifuge 5 min at 520 g and 4 °C, decant the supernatant, and resuspend the pellet in 300 µL of PBS containing 5 % BSA.

steps.title: Add antibody mastermix and stain
steps.instruction: Transfer 75 µL of the cell suspension to a new FACS tube, add 25 µL of antibody mastermix, and incubate 30 min at room temperature in the dark.

substeps.instruction: PBS/5 % BSA – 40 µL per sample (to bring mastermix to 25 µL total volume)

steps.title: Wash after staining
steps.instruction: Add 3 mL of PBS/0.5 % BSA, centrifuge 5 min at 520 g and 4 °C, and decant the supernatant.

steps.title: Final resuspension for acquisition
steps.instruction: Resuspend the pellet in 200 µL of PBS/0.5 % BSA and proceed to flow‑cytometry measurement.
